## I have read the [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/supabase/supabase/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md) file.

YES

## What kind of change does this PR introduce?

- Add support for opaque `sb_` API keys ("new API keys")
- Add support for asymmetric keys and asymmetric JWT user session tokens
- Keep it backward compatible with the legacy API keys (symmetric JWTs - `ANON_KEY` and `SERVICE_ROLE_KEY`), and symmetric JWT user session tokens
- Replicate the platform behavior for `sb_` keys substitution, per route

To test:

1. Update/add: `.env.example` (merge into `.env`), `docker-compose.yml`, `utils/add-new-auth-keys.sh`, `utils/rotate-new-api-keys.sh`, `volumes/api/kong-entrypoint.sh`, `volumes/api/kong.yml`
2. Run `utils/add-new-auth-keys.sh` and check `.env` for new env vars
3. **Uncomment** `GOTRUE_JWT_KEYS`, `API_JWT_JWKS`, and `JWT_JWKS` env vars in `docker-compose.yml` for Auth, Realtime, and Storage
4. Start containers via `docker compose up -d` and verify environment for Auth, PostgREST, Realtime, Storage, and Functions
5. (Consider using tests from PR #43573 for additional checks/debugging)

Closes #41843 (hopefully...)
title: add new opaque api keys and new auth to self-hosted
